questions.stem: A substance has a very high melting point and does not conduct electricity under any conditions. What type of structure does it most likely have?
questions.explanation: A very high melting point with no electrical conductivity under any conditions points to a giant covalent structure (like diamond or silicon dioxide). Giant covalent structures have many strong covalent bonds to break and no free electrons or ions to carry charge. Graphite is the exception, as it does conduct.
